skills.does: Add tax to a price, or work backwards from a price that already includes it, at a rate you supply.
examples: add 20% vat to 250
what is the vat included in 300 at 20%
add 8.875% sales tax to 49.99

skills.does: Grow a sum year on year, with each year’s interest earning interest too.
examples: what does 1000 grow to at 5% for 10 years
compound 5000 at 4% monthly for 5 years
save 200 a month at 6% for 20 years

skills.does: Convert an amount between currencies at an exchange rate you supply.
examples: convert 100 EUR to USD at 1.0842
50 gbp in euros at a rate of 1.18
how much is 250 dollars in yen at 150.53

skills.does: Turn an hourly wage into the yearly salary it adds up to.
examples: what is 25 an hour as a salary
annual salary for 18.50 an hour at 40 hours
15 an hour over 48 working weeks

skills.does: Convert between markup and margin, and work out a selling price from a cost.
examples: sell at 50% markup on a cost of 20
what price gives a 40% margin on cost 60
my cost is 12 and I sell at 20 — what is the margin

skills.does: Divide an annual salary down to what a single hour is worth.
examples: what is 48750 a year per hour
hourly rate for a 60000 salary at 40 hours
35000 a year as an hourly rate

skills.does: Work out how long a savings goal takes, or how much to put aside each month.
examples: how long to save 10000 at 250 a month with no interest
how many months to save 10000 at 250 a month at 3 percent
saving 100 a month at 2 percent for a 5000 goal

skills.does: Charge flat interest on the original amount only, never on the interest.
examples: simple interest on 1000 at 5% for 3 years
how much interest on 2500 at 4.5% over 2 years
interest on 500 at 10% for half a year

skills.does: Check whether two words or phrases use exactly the same letters.
examples: are listen and silent anagrams
is dormitory an anagram of dirty room
are hello and world anagrams

skills.does: Check whether a word or phrase reads the same backwards.
examples: is racecar a palindrome
check if this phrase is a palindrome
is hello a palindrome

skills.does: Give a magic eight ball answer to a yes or no question.
examples: magic eight ball, will it rain tomorrow
ask the magic 8 ball
should I take the job

skills.does: Add up what a word is worth in Scrabble tile values.
examples: what does pigeon score in scrabble
scrabble score for quiz
how many points is jazz worth

skills.does: Rearrange all the letters of a word into the other words they spell.
examples: unscramble listen
what words can I make from stop
solve the anagram tea

skills.does: Narrow a word list down from green, yellow and grey letter clues.
examples: wordle: green c at the start, k in the middle
five letters starting cr, no e
pattern .a.e. with an r somewhere

skills.does: Build every shorter word you can from a pool of letters, using some of them.
examples: what words can I make from pigeon
words from the letters stop
make words from cat

skills.does: Flip a coin for heads or tails, one flip or several, from a seed so it can be repeated.
examples: flip a coin with seed 1
flip a coin seed 7
flip 5 coins with seed 42

skills.does: Draw a month out as a printable calendar grid of weeks.
examples: show me a calendar grid for September 2026
calendar for February 2026
month grid for February 2024

skills.does: Turn your own list into tick boxes — a markdown checklist.
examples: make a checklist from these items
checklist with a heading
make a numbered checklist

skills.does: Divide a stretch of time into even slots, with optional breaks between them.
examples: split 9am to noon into three slots
ninety minute sessions from 9 to 5
three slots with fifteen minute breaks

skills.does: Generate meaningless placeholder filler to fill out a layout.
examples: generate some placeholder text
lorem ipsum with two paragraphs
filler text with a different seed

skills.does: Pick a random number in a range, from a seed so the same draw can be repeated.
examples: pick a number between 1 and 100 with seed 7
random number 1 to 6 seed 1
give me 5 numbers between 1 and 50, seed 42

skills.does: Roll dice in standard notation like 2d6+3, from a seed so the same roll can be repeated.
examples: roll 2d6 with seed 7
roll a d20 with seed 1
roll 3d8+2 seed 42

skills.does: Work out the space inside a shape — the area of a rectangle, square, circle, triangle, trapezoid, ellipse or parallelogram.
examples: area of a rectangle 8 by 5
area of a circle with radius 3
area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6

skills.does: Work out the straight-line distance between two points on a plane or in space.
examples: distance between (0,0) and (3,4)
how far apart are these two points
distance in 3d space

skills.does: Work out the great-circle distance between two points on Earth from their latitude and longitude.
examples: distance from london to paris
how far is new york from london
distance between two nearby points

skills.does: Work out the distance round the edge of a shape — its perimeter or circumference, or how much fencing or edging it takes.
examples: perimeter of a rectangle 8 by 5
circumference of a circle with radius 3
perimeter of a square with 7 metre sides

skills.does: Find a missing side of a right-angled triangle — a ladder's length, a diagonal, a hypotenuse — from the other two.
examples: hypotenuse of a triangle with sides 3 and 4

diagonal of a 1920 by 1080 screen

skills.does: Work out the volume of a cube, box, sphere, cylinder, cone or pyramid.
examples: volume of a cube with 4cm sides
volume of a box 10 by 5 by 2
volume of a sphere with radius 3

skills.does: Work out body mass index from a height and weight — the formula only.
examples: bmi for 70kg and 175cm

bmi calculation for 55kg and 160cm

skills.does: Split a maximum heart rate you supply into the standard five training zones.
examples: heart rate zones for a max of 190
training zones from a measured max of 180
zones using heart rate reserve with resting 50

skills.does: Convert between running pace, speed and finish time over a distance.
examples: finish time for a 10k at 5:30 per km

pace for a 5k in 25 minutes

skills.does: Work out wake or bedtimes a whole number of sleep cycles apart.
examples: when should I go to bed to wake at 7am

skills.does: Work out the pace and split times needed to finish a distance in a target time.
examples: split times for a 10k in 50 minutes

pace for 3 miles in 24 minutes

skills.does: Check each line of a worked calculation and find the first one that is wrong.
examples: check my working
is this calculation right
check these sums

skills.does: Shuffle a set of flashcards into a study order.
examples: shuffle my flashcards
shuffle these cards with seed 42
randomise this deck

skills.does: Work out a grade point average from letter grades and credit hours.
examples: work out my gpa

skills.does: Work out what score the remaining work needs to reach a target grade.
examples: what do I need on the final to get 80 percent

can I still pass with 70 percent

skills.does: Mark a set of answers against an answer key and give the score, question by question.
examples: mark these answers against the key
grade my quiz
score these ignoring capitals

skills.does: Turn a page count into a daily reading schedule.
examples: reading schedule for 60 pages at 20 a day
